title: Specified rational Frobenius transport commutes with finite coefficient extension

from.place: Coefficient-extension clause of (2), original proof step 3.

statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, a prime l unequal to its characteristic, finite coefficient fields E and L over Q_l, an algebra embedding i:E→L, and an object K of the raw rational constructible category on Spec(D.k). Let P_E and P_L be the specified rational pullbacks along geometric Frobenius, let S be the specified rational scalar extension, let phi be pointRationalFibreScalarIso and alpha the specified rationalPullbackScalarComparison. Write t_E(K) for the literal frobeniusPointTransportRational component followed by the fibre of the canonical equality identifying its integral-model codomain with P_E(K). Then phi_K^{-1} followed by t_L(S K), Fib_L(alpha_K^{-1}), and phi_{P_E K} equals the coefficient scalar extension of t_E(K). The equality uses exactly the fixed coefficient-size descent and object identifications of [def-weil-frobenius-point-transport], [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point], [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], [lem-weil-point-sections-scalar-extension] and [lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension].

source.place: Deligne, Weil II, (1.1.3) and (1.1.7), pp. 150–151; original coefficient-extension clause and proof step 3 of lem-weil-frobenius-point-transport-natural. Explicit normalization is agent-written.

proof.text: Identify the chain sigma with sectionwise restriction. Exact localization identifies its derived transformation with pointAutomorphismRestrictionDerived after coefficient unlift. Normalize the completed comparison on every flat-term K-flat model; uniqueness gives the integral transport identification on arbitrary derived representatives.

Apply the rational equation of point_automorphism_transport_scalar_extension to this integral component. The normalization formulas of pointRationalNormalization, pointRationalFibreScalar_existsUnique and rationalPullbackScalarComparison_existsUnique identify the literal component and both comparison maps. Conjugate the raw equation by these normalization isomorphisms, cancel inverse pairs, and use faithfulness of coefficient size lift. This works also for identity extensions and zero objects.

proof_origin.place: R1, 2026-10-25: isolate exactly the specified rational coefficient square from original step 3; normalization through completed sections and faithful coefficient lift.

theorem frobeniusPointTransportRational_scalar
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p) :
    ∀ (E' L : Type u) [Field E'] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E']
      [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E'] [Field L] [Algebra ℚ_[l] L]
      [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] L] (ι : E' →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] L)
      (K : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E' (Spec (.of D.k))),
      letI : ∀ x : Spec (.of D.k), Invertible (l : (Spec (.of D.k)).residueField x) :=
        fun x => frobeniusPointPrimeInvertible D l hl x
      (pointRationalFibreScalarIso D l hl E' L ι).inv.app K ≫
          frobeniusPointTransportRational D l hl L
            ((sfRationalScalarExtension l E' (Spec (.of D.k)) 0
              (Nat.Prime.ne_zero (Fact.out : l.Prime)) L ι).obj K) ≫
          (pointRationalFibre D l hl L).map
            (eqToHom ((fun N ↦ (rationalDerivedPullback_existsUnique l L
              (frobeniusPointIso D).hom).exists.choose_spec.2.1 N)
              ((sfRationalScalarExtension l E' (Spec (.of D.k)) 0
                (Nat.Prime.ne_zero (Fact.out : l.Prime)) L ι).obj K)).symm) ≫
          (pointRationalFibre D l hl L).map
            ((rationalPullbackScalarComparison l E' L ι
              (frobeniusPointIso D).hom).inv.app K) ≫
          (pointRationalFibreScalarIso D l hl E' L ι).hom.app
            ((rationalDerivedPullback l E' (frobeniusPointIso D).hom).obj K) =
        (DerivedCategory.pointFdScalarExtension ι.toRingHom).map
          (frobeniusPointTransportRational D l hl E' K) ≫
          (DerivedCategory.pointFdScalarExtension ι.toRingHom).map
            ((pointRationalFibre D l hl E').map
              (eqToHom ((fun N ↦ (rationalDerivedPullback_existsUnique l E'
              (frobeniusPointIso D).hom).exists.choose_spec.2.1 N) K).symm))
